component.name: Ottersnap
component.summary: Snapshot image viewer with Vulkan rendering

description.p: Ottersnap is a desktop application for viewing images using high-performance Vulkan rendering while automatically tracking and preserving their history. Open an image file and it is watched for changes; every update snapshots the previous state onto a browsable timeline.
Browse the full history of an image, extract dominant color clusters, and adjust the view with grayscale and mirroring effects.
